businessRules: Security headers are applied to every route.

Development may be verified through localhost or 127.0.0.1 on the default Next.js port; 127.0.0.1 is allowed as a dev origin so client components, HMR, and map hydration are not blocked during local QA.
External image domains must remain explicit because product, category, and asset images normally come from SHRESTA-BE or future CDN/object-storage hosts.
